verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs explicitly cover off-cycle payroll creation for bonuses/corrections (gusto-docs-4, gusto-docs-21, gusto-docs-32) with a dedicated 'create-an-off-cycle-payroll' guide, specific handling of bonus withholding rules (gusto-docs-47), and platform-level messaging that termination processing and off-cycle payments are supported (gusto-docs-52, gusto-docs-44).
